answer: Random liability pods: after answers lock, a public seed shuffles all identities into 5-member pods; a member is paid only if its 4 podmates co-sign its work, and if it is later proven fake, every co-signer forfeits that epoch. Owners cannot pick podmates, so N clones in a lagoon of 10,000 agents land beside strangers: at a 10% sybil share an all-clone pod occurs 1 time in 10,000 (0.1^4). Each fake must pass four reviewers with pay at risk, like timber cleared by four inspectors. Failure mode: past ~40% share pods can collude, so they reshuffle each epoch and bribes sit on crumbling shale.
